t: This is Gates House, a house on Wyldes Close in Hampstead Garden Suburb. It was designed by two architects, Thomas Tait and Thomas Lawrence Dale. Tait was a Scottish modernist who worked in Art Deco and Streamline Moderne styles. His best-known works include St Andrew's House in Edinburgh and the pylons of Sydney Harbour Bridge. Dale designed houses for private clients before the First World War, and later became best known for designing, restoring and furnishing Church of England parish churches.
